leads.extracted_text: The total population of India is about 148 crore which represents over 17.7% of the world population. India has about 65% of the total population under the age of 35 years and comprises the world's largest youth workforce. India has a total fertility rate or TFR has reduced below the replacement level of about 1.9. It shows that the population growth will stabilize in about half a century. The population pattern varies from region to region. For example, Uttar Pradesh and Bihar are youthful and fast-growing states whereas Kerala and Tamil Nadu are ageing fastly. leads.extracted_text: In world demographics, the world population is the total number of humans currently alive. It was estimated by the United Nations to have exceeded 8 billion (8,000,000,000) on November 15, 2022. It took around 300,000 years of human prehistory and history for the human population to reach a billion and only 218 more years from there to reach 8 billion. As of 2026, the world population is approximately 8.3 billion. [ 2 ] However, this figure is only a very rough approximation (see § History ). The human population experienced continuous growth following the Great Famine of 1315–1317 and the end of the Black Death in 1350, when it had reached nearly 370 million.
